title: Lamb and Apricot Tagine
ingredients: 600g lamb leg, diced into 2cm pieces, excess fat trimmed
couscous and natural yogurt, to serve
method: Heat the oil in a flameproof casserole dish, add the onion and cook for 5 mins until softened
Add the lamb and fry until browned
Add the garlic and spices and cook for a couple mins more, stirring to prevent them catching and burning
Add squash and apricots to the casserole, pour the tomatoes and stock in, season well and bring to the boil
Put the lid on and transfer to the oven
After 1 hr, stir the tagine and return to the oven, uncovered, for a further 30 mins
Sprinkle over the zest and coriander, and serve in warm bowls with couscous and yogurt
